text.en: Ministry of Education Singapore, Curriculum Planning and Development Division. Mathematics Syllabus Primary One to Six (implementation starting with the 2021 Primary One cohort; updated October 2025). Average of a Set of Data: p. 44; Decimals, Multiplication and Division: p. 38.
text.zh: 新加坡教育部课程规划与发展司：《小学一至六年级数学课程纲要》（2021 年版，2025 年 10 月更新）。一组数据的平均数：第 44 页；小数的乘除：第 38 页。

note.en: The only source for what each step covers; the syllabus lines are quoted from it (pages as printed on the PDF, read 2026-11-15). The division sign in "total value ÷ number of data" was checked on the page image of p. 44.
